boundary_evidence: PARTIAL RUN, 33 of 61 delink sections. tu_map calls 0x020dbe40..0x020de940 one contiguous linker run of 62 function(s) (build/tu_map.json, tools/tu_map.py). This TU licenses 0x020dbf7c..0x020dd0e0, 33 function(s), ROM ordinals 3..35. The other 28 sections keep their own shards and their own delinks.txt entries.

TWO SOURCELESS HOLES, NOT ONE, AND THEY SPLIT THE RUN INTO THREE. ROM ordinal 2, func_ov006_020dbe9c (0x020dbe9c, size 0xe0), and ROM ordinal 36, func_ov006_020dd0e0 (0x020dd0e0, size 0x1ec), have no source anywhere in the tree and no entry in config/arm9/overlays/ov006/delinks.txt at all -- the cartridge's own bytes cover both ranges. Neither is unattempted work: func_ov006_020dbe9c carries 14 logged attempts in config/match_attempts.jsonl across four models and three harnesses, best 7 divergent words, with the last three sessions all no_progress; func_ov006_020dd0e0 is banked in nearmiss/db.jsonl at 34 divergences. A near-miss never lands in src/, so bringing either in was not available. Nothing in this tree expresses a .text claim with a hole in it -- checked tree-wide on this base, 0 of 148 TU manifests and 0 delink blocks in any overlay delinks.txt carry two .text runs -- so the run can only be licensed as one of its three contiguous pieces.

WHICH SIDE, AND WHAT IT COSTS. The three pieces are: segment 1, 0x020dbe40..0x020dbe9c, 2 sections, the D1/D0 pair alone; segment 2, 0x020dbf7c..0x020dd0e0, 33 sections, this file; segment 3, 0x020dd2cc..0x020de988, 26 sections, being 25 shards plus dScMgCoin_c_classInit from src/d_s_mg_coin.cpp. Segment 2 is the largest side by shard count -- the queue's own ranking metric -- and 33 beats segment 3's ceiling of 26 even with the factory folded in. The cost is stated rather than hidden: segment 3 holds four of the six own vtable overrides (slots 0 InitResources, 6 Behavior, 9 Render, 18 OnYoshiTryEat) and the factory, so those stay in their own shards and a later promotion may take that side. A class-named TU holding no mangled class member is precedented and landed: ov006/dScMgBomroom_c (41 functions) and ov074/Goomboss (36) are both promoted with none.

THE FACTORY IS NOT EXCLUDED BY CONVENTION -- IT IS UNREACHABLE FROM THIS SIDE. dScMgCoin_c_classInit (0x020de940..0x020de988, src/d_s_mg_coin.cpp) abuts the run's top end at a zero-byte gap and is not claimed by any manifest, so it was a genuine candidate; 12 of the 20 ov006 manifests on this base do fold their own *_classInit in, including the immediate neighbour dScMgCard_c. It is out here only because it is contiguous with segment 3 and not with segment 2.

NOT A DESTRUCTOR-ORDER REFUSAL. The cartridge orders this class D1 (0x020dbe40) BELOW D0 (0x020dbe64), with no _ZN11dScMgCoin_cD2Ev in any config symbols file; that is the reproducible direction and the pair would not have blocked a whole-run promotion. The pair is out only because it lies on the far side of the first hole. Consequently this TU does not own the class's key function -- the first declared virtual is the out-of-line destructor at 0x020dbe40, in segment 1 -- so it emits no _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS, needs no compiler_only_output rows (verify reports zero unlicensed symbols and linkcheck [4b/8] reports 33 LICENSED, 0 unlicensed), and needed no edit to include/dScMgCoin_c.h. Text-only is in any case the only route available: ov006's entire .data segment (0x02133600..0x021402e0) is one delink section owned by no file, so no ov006 TU can own its own vtable.

THE pragma:2 BLOCKER IS A PHANTOM -- MEASURED, WITH THE DELETE-OUTRIGHT CONTROL. The legacy shards of func_ov006_020dca04 and func_ov006_020dcb1c each carried #pragma opt_common_subs off and #pragma opt_strength_reduction off. Three configurations were compiled on this identical 33-member set with the pinned 2004/b56: (a) #pragma defer_codegen off plus both pragmas in a push/pop bracket -> 33/33 MATCH, all 33 in ROM-ascending emission order; (b) defer_codegen off, both pragmas deleted outright -> 33/33 MATCH, ROM-ascending; (c) both pragmas deleted and defer_codegen off deleted too, source still ascending -> 33/33 MATCH but 32 ordinal pair(s) NOT in ROM order. (a) and (b) are byte-identical, so both pragmas buy zero members here and are gone from the shipped file. This is the dScMgRoulette_c verdict, not the dScMgHanachan_c one, on the same overlay and the same pragma pair -- the queue column counts shards carrying a #pragma line and is not evidence either way.

SOURCE ORDER IS ROM-ASCENDING, lowest address first, and #pragma defer_codegen off is what makes that admissible: control (c) above is the measurement -- dropping that one line from this ascending file costs nothing in bytes and inverts emission order to 32 out-of-order pairs, which linkcheck [4b/8] hard-refuses.

RATCHET-NEUTRAL. None of the 33 absorbed shards appears in config/converted-baseline.json (2680 entries). The three dScMgCoin_c files that do -- src/_ZN11dScMgCoin_cD1Ev.cpp, src/_ZN11dScMgCoin_cD0Ev.cpp and src/_ZN11dScMgCoin_c6RenderEv.cpp -- are all outside the licensed range and stay enrolled, so tiers_ratchet --update was deliberately NOT run and nothing was banked.

OUTPUT PATH: src/actors/dScMgCoin_c.cpp. The manifest's generated promoted_source already named this path; it is also PIPELINE.md's stage-2 convention and the shape the seven most recent ov006 promotions use, against the older src/minigames/d_s_mg_*.cpp group.
